author: Policy Wind Tunnel team, from help.shopee.vn article 79294 and the official pages quoted in docs/research/policy-sources.md; every fact cites the sentences that state it.

facts.text: The article gives three alternative reasons why COD cannot be selected; any one of them is enough.
COD is not offered when the seller does not use Shopee's shipping methods and does not offer COD for that product (examples: e-codes for phone top-up, e-cinema tickets).
An account can be temporarily limited from COD for 24 hours when it has exceeded the limit on the number of orders placed with COD in one day.
Shopee can temporarily turn off a buyer's COD when the system records that the buyer's purchase history has a number of failed COD deliveries exceeding the current rule.
Shopee monitors the buyer's payment activity and sends a reminder notification each time a COD order is not delivered successfully.
Under the 24-hour limit, the buyer should try again after 24 hours.
If COD still cannot be selected after 24 hours, the account may instead be in the case where Shopee has temporarily turned COD off.

When Shopee has turned COD off, the system checks the buyer's successful purchases every day; buying and successfully receiving orders paid with other available methods lets the system record them and turn COD back on automatically once the buyer is eligible.
At checkout, COD is shown as temporarily unavailable and the buyer is asked to choose another payment method.
Shopee's shipping policy tells buyers to refuse a parcel whose packaging shows damage (torn, dented, broken, wet) or is no longer intact.
If COD was locked because a shipper updated a delivery as failed or returned without contacting the buyer, the buyer should contact Shopee customer service (CSKH).
Shopee's seller education page says Shopee tracks failed COD orders caused by buyers refusing delivery and may restrict COD for buyers with a history of inappropriate refusals.

notCovered.text: How many failed COD deliveries trigger the COD turn-off (the article says only 'exceeding the current rule').
Over what time window failed COD deliveries are counted.
Whether failures not caused by the buyer (wrong address set by the courier, unreachable courier, a damaged parcel refused, a shipper marking failure falsely) count toward the turn-off.
How many successful orders, or how long, it takes for COD to be turned back on; what 'eligible' means.
How long the COD turn-off lasts if nothing changes; the article states no fixed duration.
How many COD orders per day trigger the 24-hour limit.
Which of the three reasons applies to a given buyer when checkout says COD is unavailable.

correctReadings.question: Does Shopee lock COD after 3 failed deliveries in 90 days?
correctReadings.answer: The article does not say. It gives no number of failed deliveries and no time window; it says only that the number exceeded the current rule.

correctReadings.question: Is the 24-hour limit caused by failed deliveries?
correctReadings.answer: No. The 24-hour limit is about placing too many COD orders in one day. Failed deliveries lead to the separate, temporary COD turn-off.

correctReadings.question: How do I get COD back after Shopee turned it off?
correctReadings.answer: Buy and successfully receive orders paid with other methods; the system checks daily and turns COD back on automatically once you are eligible. The article gives no number of orders or waiting period.

correctReadings.question: COD is still unavailable after 24 hours. What does that mean?
correctReadings.answer: The account may be in the case where Shopee has temporarily turned COD off because of failed COD deliveries, not the 24-hour limit.

correctReadings.question: Can I pay COD for a phone top-up code?
correctReadings.answer: Not when the seller does not use Shopee shipping and does not offer COD for that product; e-codes are the article's own example.
